hooks.name: Agent stop gate
hooks.description: Blocks completion while any property/invariant test in the workspace is failing. Runs the full turbo test suite on Stop and exits non-zero if red.

action.command: cd "$KIRO_WORKSPACE_ROOT" && pnpm test >/tmp/afterglow-stop-gate.log 2>&1 || { echo "Agent stop gate: invariant tests are RED. Fix before completing." >&2; tail -40 /tmp/afterglow-stop-gate.log >&2; exit 2; }
